<!-- caipe-pr-skills:v1 {"task":"calibration-task","head":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","used":["sentry-find-bugs","trailofbits-differential-review","trailofbits-fp-check","anthropic-code-review"]} -->

findings.trigger: A user with read access to only project A calls GET in api/gists.js. requireProjectRead passes, then collection.find({}) runs with no project_id filter.
findings.impact: The response contains every private gist in the collection, including those of projects B, C and so on. This is a cross-project data disclosure, and it bypasses the authorization that was just performed.
findings.fix: Restore the project scope: `collection.find({project_id: project.id})`. Alternatively, call the existing `projectGists(project.id, collection)` helper from storage/project-gists.js.
findings.body:
**🔴 Critical · Security**
**Scope the gist query to the authorized project.**

In `GET`, `requireProjectRead` authorizes only project A, but `collection.find({})` has no `project_id` filter. Any project reader therefore receives all private gists from every project. Restore `collection.find({project_id: project.id})`, or call `projectGists(project.id, collection)`.

Attribution: found by sentry-find-bugs; verified by trailofbits-fp-check.
